name: Valles Marineris representative faults
source: USGS Scientific Investigations Map 3292 structure layer (Tanaka et al., 2014)
schema_note: Drop-in replacement for this file. Keep a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of LineStrings in degrees (longitude, latitude; west negative). properties.kinematics must be 'normal' or 'thrust'. Optional dip_deg overrides the spreadsheet dip slider. Optional dip_azimuth_deg (clockwise from north) overrides the default, which is the right-hand normal of each digitized segment. SIM 3292 stores graben axes and ridge crests, not dipping planes, so the default dip azimuth is only a placeholder.
